verdict.rationale: Bland's docs say developers can pick a built-in voice, clone their own from about ten seconds of clean audio, and set voice defaults. That gives a path to the voice they want, but nothing shows how broad the built-in library is or that outside TTS providers can be plugged in. Missing for 10: evidence of library size or variety, support for multiple or third-party TTS providers, independent or hands-on corroboration of voice quality.
